*Excelerate to advance Caribbean growth strategy with new offshore LNG storage and distribution terminal to be located near the island of Grand Bahama*


*AxDo Bahamas to serve as anchor customer under 11-year LNG supply agreement*


**THE WOODLANDS, Texas – November 5, 2026 –** Excelerate Energy, Inc. (“Excelerate”) (NYSE: EE) and AxDo Bahamas Ltd. (“AxDo”) – a joint venture between Axpo, an international leader in energy trading and marketing, and Bahamas-based energy and maritime logistics company Domicisle LNG – today announced an 11-year LNG supply agreement supporting development of the Bahamas LNG Hub.


Under the agreement, AxDo, established in October 2026 to conduct small-scale LNG and bunkering operations in the region, will become an anchor customer of Excelerate’s planned offshore LNG storage and distribution terminal near the island of Grand Bahama. The supply agreement provides for deliveries of up to 16 trillion British thermal units (TBtu) of LNG a year, establishing a long-term commercial foundation for the project.


The combination of AxDo’s shipping and bunkering expertise with Excelerate’s LNG infrastructure and supply capabilities is intended to help meet growing LNG demand across The Bahamas and the broader Caribbean.


“The Bahamas LNG Hub demonstrates the potential of our integrated platform to create new opportunities around our infrastructure,” said Oliver Simpson, Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer of Excelerate Energy. “By combining LNG supply, logistics and infrastructure with strong downstream partners, we can develop new markets and expand access to natural gas across the region. We’re pleased to partner with AxDo and look forward to supporting growing demand in The Bahamas and throughout the Caribbean.”


Axpo’s Head of Small-Scale LNG Daniele Corti said, “Reliable access to energy is essential for the continued development of The Bahamas and the wider Caribbean. Axpo brings extensive experience in energy markets and international supply chains. This agreement allows us to apply that know-how to the Caribbean, working with key partners Excelerate and Domicisle to support the development of a flexible LNG hub for The Bahamas and the wider region.”


Domicisle LNG Chief Executive Officer Greg Buffington added, “This agreement represents an important step forward for The Bahamas and for the development of a reliable LNG supply network across our islands. As a Bahamian-based company, our focus is on making cleaner-burning natural gas more accessible to power producers, marine operators and communities that need dependable energy. By combining Domicisle’s local market knowledge and distribution capabilities with Axpo’s international energy expertise and Excelerate’s LNG infrastructure, we are building a practical foundation for long-term energy security and economic growth in The Bahamas and the wider Caribbean.”


**A Strategic LNG Hub for The Bahamas**


The planned Bahamas LNG Hub is intended to support growing LNG demand in The Bahamas and throughout the Caribbean. The project is designed to provide LNG storage and distribution services for marine bunkering, power generation, and other downstream customers while expanding access to natural gas across the region.


Initial LNG deliveries are expected to begin in 2027 utilizing existing LNG supply and logistics capabilities from Excelerate’s Jamaica platform. A second phase is expected to include deployment of a floating storage unit (FSU) near Grand Bahama in 2028,


subject to final permitting and construction timelines, and other contractual provisions. The FSU will serve as the offshore LNG storage and distribution terminal.


Located in one of the Caribbean’s busiest maritime corridors, Grand Bahama is strategically positioned to support cruise ship bunkering, power generation and regional LNG distribution demand while enhancing regional LNG logistics capabilities and energy security.


**About Excelerate Energy**


Excelerate Energy, Inc. is a U.S.-based LNG and power infrastructure company located in The Woodlands, Texas. Excelerate helps countries around the world enhance their energy security by providing reliable energy infrastructure and increasing access to global LNG markets. The Company delivers services along the LNG-to-power value chain, including floating regasification terminals, downstream infrastructure development, LNG supply, and power generation. Excelerate has a presence in Abu Dhabi, Antwerp, Aqaba, Boston, Buenos Aires, Chattogram, Dhaka, Doha, Dubai, Hanoi, Helsinki, Jamaica, Karachi, London, Rio de Janeiro, Singapore, Washington, D.C., and Wilhelmshaven. For more information, please visit


[www.excelerateenergy.com](http://www.excelerateenergy.com/) .


**About Axpo**


Axpo is driven by a single purpose – to enable a sustainable future through innovative energy solutions. Axpo is Switzerland’s largest energy producer and an international leader in energy trading and the marketing of solar and wind power. Axpo combines the experience and expertise of about 7,500 employees who are driven by a passion for innovation, collaboration and impactful change. Using cutting-edge technologies, Axpo innovates to meet the evolving needs of its customers in more than 30 countries across Europe, North America and Asia.


**About Domicisle LNG**


Domicisle LNG is a Bahamas-based energy company focused on developing liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply, distribution and marine logistics solutions for The Bahamas and the wider Caribbean. The company works to expand access to dependable, cleaner-burning fuel for electricity generation, marine bunkering and commercial and industrial customers, including communities throughout the Family Islands. Through its participation in AxDo Bahamas Limited, a joint venture with Axpo, Domicisle LNG combines local knowledge and downstream market development with international LNG sourcing and infrastructure expertise.
